title: Scale, Drivers, and Limits of Representational Alignment Across Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.14476v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Comparing large language models can reveal shared representational structure and systematic differences between them. However, aggregate similarity measures can obscure how agreement varies across geometric scales and which linguistic properties support it. We introduce two complementary methods to resolve where models agree and what supports that agreement. Standard representational similarity analysis (RSA) summarizes similarity across all stimulus pairs, potentially obscuring differences in alignment between nearby and distant inputs. Neighborhood-Weighted RSA (NW-RSA) addresses this limitation by weighting stimulus pairs according to their proximity in representational space, placing alignment from local neighborhoods to global geometry on a common scale. translated_title: 跨大语言模型表征对齐的尺度、驱动因素与局限
translated_abstract: 比较大语言模型可以揭示它们之间共享的表征结构和系统性差异。然而，聚合的相似性度量可能会掩盖一致性在不同几何尺度上的变化，以及哪些语言属性支持这种一致性。我们引入了两种互补的方法，用于确定模型在何处一致以及是什么支持了这种一致。标准的表征相似性分析（RSA）对所有刺激对之间的相似性进行汇总，可能会掩盖相近输入与远距离输入之间对齐程度的差异。邻域加权RSA（NW-RSA）通过根据刺激对在表征空间中的邻近程度进行加权来克服这一局限，将从局部邻域到全局几何的对齐放在同一尺度上进行衡量。反事实RSA（CF-RSA）则通过将一个模型中的完整表征与受控语言扰动下的表征进行比较，来检验哪些语言属性支持这种对齐……
tldr: 该论文提出了两种互补的表征比较新方法——邻域加权RSA（NW-RSA）和反事实RSA（CF-RSA），能够在从局部邻域到全局几何的统一尺度上刻画大语言模型之间表征对齐的程度，并识别出支持这种对齐的具体语言属性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two complementary methods, Neighborhood-Weighted RSA (NW-RSA) and Counterfactual RSA (CF-RSA), which measure representational alignment between large language models across geometric scales from local neighborhoods to global structure and identify the linguistic properties that support it.
